note: Maps (source class, metric family) -> high/medium/low so the Health Monitor (EPIC-27) can label how much a given number is worth without pretending every source is equal (plan §15 'Device/source registry + sensor-quality map', §4 principle 9 'sensor-quality labeling is a required feature, not a nice-to-have'). This is an HONESTY surface, not a ranking: a 'low' label means BADAN will show the number and export it unchanged while telling the user what produced it. Quality NEVER suppresses, hides, or paywalls a reading — raw data is not paywalled, and dedup/reconciliation is decided by the separate source-priority + dedup-journal machinery (I3, I4), not by this file. A source class is a statement about the SENSOR, not about the person: 'low' on wrist-measured blood pressure is a fact about optical wrist sensors, and the copy must read that way ('wrist sensors estimate this') rather than as doubt about the user.

levels.high: The sensor class is the appropriate instrument for this family; the number can be read at face value.
levels.medium: A reasonable estimate from this sensor class; useful for trends over time, less so for a single absolute reading.
levels.low: This sensor class only infers the family indirectly. Show the value, show the caveat, and prefer direction over absolutes.
levels.unsupported: This sensor class does not produce this family at all; a value arriving here means it was relayed from somewhere else and the relay is what should be labelled.

resolution.orderEn: Resolve a row's label as: (1) its source's assigned sourceClassId, (2) the sourceTypeDefaults entry for its source type, (3) unknown.
resolution.assignedBy: Class assignment from device model + source type is EPIC-27's job and lives in code, not here — model-string matching is vendor-specific and churns faster than a shared contract should. This file deliberately contains no model-string matchers so it never becomes a stale allowlist that silently mislabels a device it has not heard of.
resolution.derivedFamilies: readiness, effort, and stress carry no entries of their own. A derived value inherits the LOWEST quality among the sources that fed it, so a readiness score built partly on a phone-estimated input is labelled by that input rather than by its best one. Optimistic inheritance would let a score launder a weak input into a confident-looking number, which is exactly what the anatomy sheet exists to prevent.
resolution.unknownFamily: A family with no entry for a class falls back to defaultQuality rather than to 'high'. An unlabelled new family must degrade toward caution.

sourceClasses.descriptionEn: Optical heart-rate sensing at the wrist, plus motion and (on some models) skin temperature.
sourceClasses.descriptionAr: استشعار ضوئي للنبض من المعصم، مع الحركة وحرارة الجلد في بعض الطُرز.

familyNotes.sleep: Stage estimates from a wrist device are inferred from motion and heart rate, not measured directly — reliable for duration, directional for stages.
familyNotes.body: Wrist devices do not measure body composition; anything in this family arrived from elsewhere or is an estimate.
familyNotes.cycle: Wrist temperature deviation is a supporting signal that a person may choose to read alongside their own recorded dates — never a standalone determination.

sourceClasses.descriptionEn: Finger-worn optical sensing with skin temperature; strong at rest, less so during motion.
sourceClasses.descriptionAr: استشعار ضوئي من الإصبع مع حرارة الجلد؛ دقيق أثناء الراحة وأقل أثناء الحركة.

familyNotes.workout: Finger-worn optical sensing degrades under grip and impact, so workout heart rate from a ring is the weakest thing it produces.

sourceClasses.descriptionEn: Electrical heart-rate sensing at the chest — the reference instrument for beat-to-beat timing.
sourceClasses.descriptionAr: استشعار كهربائي للنبض من الصدر — المرجع الأدق لتوقيت النبضات.

familyNotes.activity: A chest strap has no step or distance sensing; activity values relayed through one came from a paired device.

sourceClasses.descriptionEn: Motion, barometer, and location sensors in a device that is not always carried.
sourceClasses.descriptionAr: مستشعرات الحركة والضغط والموقع في جهاز لا يُحمل دائماً.

familyNotes.activity: Undercounts whenever the phone is set down — the gap is the phone's, not the person's, and the copy must say so rather than implying an inactive day.

sourceClasses.descriptionEn: Weight by load cell (accurate) plus body composition by bioimpedance (estimated).
sourceClasses.descriptionAr: الوزن بخلية حِمل (دقيق) مع تقدير تركيب الجسم بالمقاومة الحيوية.

familyNotes.body: Weight from a scale is high quality; body-fat and lean-mass percentages from the same scale are bioimpedance estimates that shift with hydration and time of day. The family label is capped at medium because one id (body.weight) cannot carry a better label than the family it shares with body.fat_pct — split this entry per-metric if that ever becomes limiting.

sourceClasses.descriptionEn: Oscillometric upper-arm cuff — the appropriate instrument for blood pressure.
sourceClasses.descriptionAr: جهاز ضغط بكُم للذراع — الأداة المناسبة لقياس ضغط الدم.

sourceClasses.descriptionEn: A medically-cleared instrument or an accredited laboratory.
sourceClasses.descriptionAr: جهاز معتمد طبياً أو مختبر معتمد.

familyNotes.lab: A high label here describes the instrument's accuracy only. BADAN still never interprets a lab value — reference ranges and flags shown to the user are the ones the report itself carried.

sourceClasses.descriptionEn: Typed in by the person, from a reading, a label, or their own account of the day.
sourceClasses.descriptionAr: أدخلها الشخص بنفسه من قراءة أو ملصق أو من واقع يومه.

familyNotes.subjective: How someone feels is not estimated by any sensor — the person is the instrument, and this is the highest-quality source there is for it.
familyNotes.cycle: Recorded period dates are first-hand fact, not inference; they outrank every sensor signal in this family.
familyNotes.body: I4 already makes a manual weight/BP/lab entry authoritative over a device reading in reconciliation. The medium label here is about transcription slips, and must never be surfaced as doubt about the person.

sourceClasses.descriptionEn: Data brought in from another app's export; the original instrument is usually not recoverable from the file.
sourceClasses.descriptionAr: بيانات مستوردة من تصدير تطبيق آخر، وغالباً لا يمكن معرفة الجهاز الأصلي منها.

familyNotes.sleep: Uniformly medium on purpose: the honest statement about an imported file is that the sensor behind it is unknown, and a per-family guess would be inventing information the file did not contain.

sourceClasses.descriptionEn: A connected app or device BADAN has no sensor profile for.
sourceClasses.descriptionAr: تطبيق أو جهاز متصل لا يملك BADAN وصفاً لمستشعراته.

familyNotes.heart: The default class for anything arriving through HealthKit or Health Connect until EPIC-27 identifies the originating device. 'Unrecognised' is a statement about BADAN's knowledge, not about the data — the label copy must not imply the reading is suspect.
